name: Guatemala port observation zones: inactive V2 TRAIN pilot
crs_note: RFC7946 longitude/latitude WGS84; metrics require local projected CRS
attribution_policy: Existing cross-port attribution is preserved. Additional 250m water belongs to the same port's muelles and excludes every V1 zone and previously assigned addition. Shared boundaries have one owner: lexicographically first port_id. Within-port V1 overlaps remain documented; aggregate area uses union, never the sum of zones.
